text:
deploybot: Scheduled deploy 'slate' -> targets: api@v2.7.1, runtime@3.4.0, console@1.11.0, router@2.9.3. Canary window 30m. Traffic plan: 0->10->30->60->100 over 30m with health checks.

maria: heads up — this touches the router header rewrite and console route mapping. Need pin for router schema compatibility.

aj: noted. router schema pinned to 2.9.3, console expects the new route flag behind `feature.slate` (opt-in). Confirmed with product.

lee: runtime change includes a KV cache eviction tweak. If canary p95 increases >15% we should consider immediate rollback.

sanjay: rollback criteria proposal:
- 5xx rate >0.5% over 5m OR
- p95 latency increase >200ms over baseline OR
- error spikes in console UI route mapping >= 3 distinct customers in 15m
- deployment bot detects model mismatch between API and runtime (schema version mismatch)

maria: adding: any data-plane auth failures (401/403) in dedicated regions => rollback. Also keep an eye on token usage anomalies.

deploybot: @channel canary starting now — wave 1 -> 10% traffic to runtime@3.4.0 + router@2.9.3. Monitoring dashboards: slate-canary (latency, 5xx, route-errors).

ops-bot: Canary metrics stream: https://dash.redwood/s/s/s/s/SLATE-CANARY (auto-updates)

oncall-jess: watching. oncall pager duty is set to 'high' for 45m. Ping me @here if thresholds hit.

(15m)
deploybot: Canary wave -> 30%. No degradations flagged by health hook.

aj: quick smoke: local e2e for console route mapping passed. sampled requests show header rewrite present.

(25m)
lee: observing a small p95 bump ~12% but within expected for KV warmup. No 5xx.

sanjay: I'm seeing 2 console route mapping errors in the logs — both from same tenant test account. Investigating whether it's config drift.

maria: can you paste the log sample?

sanjay: log snippet:
```
ERROR slate-router: route mapping failed: unknown route "slate-legacy" tenant=acct-42 request_id=abcd-1234
```

aj: that tenant still had an old route override in account settings. Not a product regression.

(35m)
deploybot: Canary -> 60%. Health checks continue green.

maria: requesting pin for api rollout: hold api v2.7.1 until 11:10PT for final docs sync. Can continue runtime/router/console waves.

deploybot: api pinned per request — traffic to api@v2.7.1 is held at 30% until 11:10PT. Other services continue.

(45m)
lee: runtime p95 back to baseline. KV warming finished. :thumbsup:

oncall-jess: no alerts. I'm comfortable with planned rollforward after api unhold.

(55m)
sanjay: found one remaining account override — cleared. Re-running a small batch of smoke tests against console routes.

(60m)
deploybot: api hold released by request of @maria. Beginning final traffic shift to api@v2.7.1 -> 100% over 5m.

(63m)
ops-bot: Realtime checks: 5xx=0.04% (baseline 0.03%), p95 +8ms. No auth failures.

maria: verified release notes published: https://docs.redwood/slate-release-notes (includes rollout steps + rollback instructions).

aj: pre-rollback playbook confirmed: `scripts/rollbacks/slate_rollback.sh` — will execute staged router revert then runtime rollback, then api pin back to v2.7.0.

(70m)
deploybot: Rollforward decision: clear. Promoting to 100% complete.

maria: tagging release in git: `release/slate-2024-11-05` (refs api@v2.7.1, runtime@3.4.0, console@1.11.0, router@2.9.3).

lee: follow-up items logged in backlog: KV metrics alert tuning, add better tenant config drift detection.

sanjay: I'll create a short post-deploy runbook entry about the tenant override edge-case.

oncall-jess: great job. Close the window and archive this thread once the release note link is in the release email.

deploybot: Deploy 'slate' -> SUCCESS. All services at target versions. Canary window closed. :tada:

maria: thanks everyone. Filing a single-line postmortem for the minor tenant drift noise.

aj: ack. Will coordinate release email.

(2h after start)
ops-bot: 2h health check: 5xx steady at 0.03%, p95 within 5ms of baseline. No regressions.

oncall-jess: handing back to normal ops. Good deploy. :white_check_mark:
